+# Graham — SWE Quick Reference
+
+## Engineering background
+
+Graham is a full-stack software engineer with experience in financial and legal technology. His strengths include backend APIs, customer interfaces, domain modelling, workflow automation, integration reliability, production debugging and developer tooling.
+
+## Technical skills
+
+- **Languages:** TypeScript, JavaScript and Java; Python for algorithms practice.
+- **Frontend:** React, Next.js and Angular; complex forms, validation, state persistence and mobile layouts.
+- **Backend and data:** Node.js, NestJS, Spring, MongoDB, Mongoose and Zod; versioned snapshots, historical data integrity and state-driven workflows.
+- **Testing and delivery:** Jest, Playwright, GitHub Actions, Jenkins and monorepo test routing.
+- **Operations:** Sentry, structured logging, AWS diagnostics and disaster-recovery support. AWS and Docker are listed in his technical background.
+- **Automation and integrations:** Registry APIs, accounting, CRM, Google Drive, Camunda BPMN tooling, and DOCX/PDF generation with Gotenberg.
+- **Applied AI:** Azure OpenAI, Responses API migration, AI Gateway routing and reusable AI-assisted engineering workflows.
+
+## Representative engineering work
+
+- **Corporate-change platform:** Led a substantial initiative and built core APIs, customer ordering/intake flows, versioned domain models and automated fulfilment, with contributions from teammates.
+- **Historical data integrity:** Modelled before/after company and person snapshots, role changes and share transfers; added safeguards for invalid or duplicate drafts.
+- **Document automation:** Built conditional document payloads and rendering workflows. Reported generation time fell from approximately 55 to 25 seconds in one tested flow through parallel processing.
+- **Reliable integrations:** Implemented registry publication tracking, event-driven document synchronisation, guarded backfills and duplicate-safe invoice retry handling.
+- **Developer feedback:** Improved targeted PR test selection and workspace routing while retaining full nightly test and coverage workflows.
+- **Enterprise workflows:** Built Angular and Java/Spring document platforms, React plugins for BPMN modelling tools, and automated regression tests.
+- **Operational problem solving:** Diagnosed production and shared-dependency failures, coordinated fixes, strengthened authentication and exposed actionable failure states to operators.
+
+## How to work with Graham
+
+- Keep explanations short and concrete; use a working example when helpful.
+- Give one focused question or next step at a time.
+- Avoid dense information and multiple consecutive code blocks.
+- For algorithm coaching, let Graham reason before supplying the solution; preserve supplied code structure unless correctness requires a change.
+
+## Claim accuracy
+
+Use this as technical context, not independent verification. Preserve personal contribution versus team delivery and reported results versus measured results. Do not infer production model-training expertise, certifications, formal management responsibility or hands-on experience with unlisted tools. Keep Python algorithms practice separate from production Python ownership, and Spring separate from unconfirmed Spring Boot experience.
*** End Patch"));
